module: Grid selector utility: generic tile production engine. From a config (item -> tile converter, handlers per path type, grouping, sorting, data source), it routes each tile request to the handler matching the first key of the path and gives that handler a "context" of helpers (group finalization, default selection, clustering, favorites/recents groups).
notes: The handler is looked up in config.pathHandlers[path.keys[1]]; if it does not exist, getTiles returns an empty table.
The hook `onGridSelectorGetTiles(backendName, pathType)` is only emitted if `pathChanged` is true.
finalizeGroups: limits the "recents" group to 15 tiles, removes empty groups and sorts by `order` then by name (sortingModule.sortByNameButOtherAlwaysLast).

setDefaultSelection: default tile = the model's default_pc, otherwise the tile imposed by overrideDefaultSelectedTile (forceAutoFocus = true), otherwise the last tile of the group; it gets isDefaultSelected = true.

In matchesGroup, the local variable groupName shadows the parameter of the same name (`local groupName, _ = ...`); the final test `validGroups[groupName]` uses the original parameter, so it stays consistent but the code is misleading. The Favourites/Recent modes always return true (filtering left to the caller).
The profiler is disabled (empty functions); a commented-out line allows enabling it.

config.desc: { itemToTileConverter, pathHandlers (table pathType -> function(path, data, context)), clusteringFunction, groupingModule, sortingModule, getDataFunction, filterFunction, backendName (default "gridSelector"), profilerName }.

getTiles.desc: Calls getDataFunction(), builds the context and delegates to the handler of the first path segment. Returns the handler's result (list of groups) or {}.

overrideDefaultSelectedTile.desc: Tile { key } to select by default.

tileFromClusteredItems.desc: Cluster tile factories per clustering mode.

createContext.desc: Builds the context passed to the handlers: itemToTileConverter, filterFunction, clusteringFunction, groupingModule, sortingModule, finalizeGroups, setDefaultSelection, matchesGroup, processClusteredItems, handleSpecialGroups, profiler, backendName, data.
